versions.summary: Short-side fix and risk gates, chosen by a full-pipeline backtest: Sharpe 0.37 -> 0.79, max drawdown -13% -> -7.6% over 113 weeks; positive in both halves.
changes: Shorts only after a 1-month bounce (1M return > 0) and no more than 3% below the 21D; momentum-laggard shorts barred
Stretch cap: no entry more than 2 monthly sigmas beyond the 21D in the trade's direction
Earnings gate: legs reporting within 7 days of the Monday entry are dropped and refilled
Each leg's 60D beta vs the S&P; tickets show the pair's net beta and a beta-neutral split
Only conviction 3+ pairs published; 10-15 pairs per run
Borrow check on short legs in the review when IBKR tools are available
tools/backtest.py + backtest workflow: select -> pair -> one-week P&L replay, by variant and by half
